chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him): 'I had gifted a slave girl to my daughter when I married her off. She remained with her in her husband's house until her husband died, and then she returned to me, along with the slave girl. Is it permissible for me to have sexual relations with the slave girl?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Assess her at a just price, and bear witness to that, then if you wish, have relations with her.'

key_terms.أَطَأَهَا: I had sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a father who wants to marry a slave girl he previously gifted to his daughter?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the legal status of a slave girl gifted to a daughter, resolving the ambiguity of whether she remains the daughter's property or reverts to the father. Imam al-Rida (AS) prescribes a formal valuation and transaction to establish clear ownership, thereby permitting the father to have conjugal relations with her. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on precise property rights and the distinction between gift (hibah) and sale (bay') in determining mahram and non-mahram relationships within the family structure.
